headline: Executive order directs federal government action concerning the law firm Perkins Coie LLP, based on risks the administration says the firm poses.
what_it_does: This executive order is aimed at one private law firm, Perkins Coie LLP. The title says it addresses risks the administration links to the firm. No summary was provided, so the specific steps the order orders federal agencies to take are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Perkins Coie LLP and its lawyers and staff
who_it_affects.how: The order is directed at this firm, so its people are the main ones affected by whatever actions it requires.
Businesses and individuals who use the firm may be indirectly affected by federal actions taken toward it.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 6, 2025; the source gives no separate effective date.
